lines.speak: Claude! I built a website, but the design looks terrible. And I don't even know if everything works!
lines.show: Claude! I built a website, but the design looks terrible. And I don't even know if everything works!

lines.speak: Hey, don't worry! Anthropic has Agent Skills that can help with exactly that.
lines.show: Hey, don't worry! Anthropic has Agent Skills that can help with exactly that.

lines.speak: Skills? What do they actually do?
lines.show: Skills? What do they actually do?

lines.speak: They're reusable instructions and tools that teach me how to handle specific tasks, like designing websites, testing apps, and creating new workflows.
lines.show: They're reusable instructions and tools that teach me how to handle specific tasks, like designing websites, testing apps, and creating new workflows.

lines.speak: For your design problem, we can use the frontend-design skill. I ran it on your page. New fonts, colors and layout. It even fixed a bug: your order buttons updated an element that doesn't exist.
lines.show: For your design problem, we can use the frontend-design skill. I ran it on your page. New fonts, colors and layout. It even fixed a bug: your order buttons updated an element that doesn't exist.

lines.speak: Wait... that looks so much better!
lines.show: Wait... that looks so much better!

lines.speak: But how do I know the website actually works?
lines.show: But how do I know the website actually works?

lines.speak: That's where webapp-testing helps. We can check interactions and find problems before you publish. I ran thirteen checks. Nine passed. Four failed: the email box accepts broken addresses like just an at sign.
lines.show: That's where webapp-testing helps. We can check interactions and find problems before you publish. I ran 13 checks. 9 passed. 4 failed: the email box accepts broken addresses like just an @ sign.

lines.speak: Skills don't make a site perfect, but they help me catch problems early.
lines.show: Skills don't make a site perfect, but they help me catch problems early.

lines.speak: Okay, I need these skills! How do I install them?
lines.show: Okay, I need these skills! How do I install them?

lines.speak: Open Claude Code, add Anthropic's official skill marketplace, then install the example-skills plugin.
lines.show: Open Claude Code, add Anthropic's official skill marketplace, then install the example-skills plugin.

lines.speak: That's it. frontend-design, webapp-testing and skill-creator are now ready to use.
lines.show: That's it. frontend-design, webapp-testing and skill-creator are now ready to use.

lines.speak: So instead of explaining everything from scratch, I can use the right skill for the job?
lines.show: So instead of explaining everything from scratch, I can use the right skill for the job?

lines.speak: Exactly. And you can create your own reusable skills too!
lines.show: Exactly. And you can create your own reusable skills too!

lines.speak: Try the official Anthropic skills and see what you can build.
lines.show: Try the official Anthropic skills and see what you can build.
